name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Family Adventure, Learning and Accessibility Expansion
changes: Added individualized, age-appropriate Princess Mode reflection questions with three discussion choices and explanatory feedback; choices are exploratory, not marked right or wrong.
Added an optional 30, 60 or 90-second charades timer with pause and reset; timeout never auto-skips or penalizes a child.
Added 2–4 family teams, rotating turns and persistent scores.
Added up to four local player profiles with separate Classic and Princess progress snapshots.
Added a parent challenge editor to create, edit and delete custom Classic Mode challenges; custom challenge data is included in backup export/import.
Migrated the drawing gallery to IndexedDB, with localStorage migration/fallback, larger collections, titles, dates, search and sorting.
Added a five-region Kingdom Adventure Map driven by current profile and mode completion.
Added printable achievement certificates; browser Print can save them as PDF.
Added text scaling, high contrast, reduced motion and adjustable speech rate.
Added V50 browser smoke tests and expanded release integrity tests.
Preserved V49 challenge banks, Princess Album, artwork, drawing tools, offline PWA and existing saved progress.
